compatibility_repair.before: [t, y] = ode23s(@(t, y) reduced(t, y, tnf), [tspan_begin, tspan_end], species(end, :), tnf);
compatibility_repair.after: [t, y] = ode23s(@(t, y) reduced(t, y, tnf), [tspan_begin, tspan_end], species(end, :), []);
compatibility_repair.mechanical_basis: The anonymous ODE function already captures tnf. MATLAB ode23s interprets the fourth positional argument as the options structure, so replacing the invalid numeric options value with [] preserves the RHS, TNF input, parameters, time span, initial condition, solver family, and biological model.
